en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a European town seen across treetops, with dense low-rise buildings and, dominating the skyline, a large Gothic-style church or cathedral featuring two very tall, slender spires. Rolling hills rise in the far background. The image has rough, worn edges and some surface damage typical of early photographic postcards. No visible caption or printed text appears on the front.
